sentences.text: Pre-operative multi-sequence MRI: axial T1, contrast-enhanced T1 (T1ce), T2 and FLAIR, co-registered, skull-stripped and resampled to 1 mm isotropic (BraTS preparation).
The tumour contains a necrotic / non-enhancing core (confidence 0.51). This finding is low-confidence and is hedged accordingly.
The whole-tumour mass is predominantly left-sided (confidence 1.00).
An enhancing tumour component is present (confidence 1.00).
Whole-tumour burden is assessed as large (volume tercile fitted on the training split; confidence 0.60). This finding is low-confidence and is hedged accordingly.
The enhancing fraction of the whole tumour is mid (ET/WT tercile fitted on the training split; confidence 0.75).
Acquisition quality (cjv, efc, snr, sharpness, inu, contrast, entropy) is mildly outside the training cohort range (mean |z| = 0.91); interpret borderline findings with corresponding caution.
DEFERRED TO RADIOLOGIST: case confidence 0.51 is below the calibrated gate threshold 0.55.
For radiologist confirmation: ncr_present present (p=0.51); laterality left (p=1.00).
